item.description:
### Changed - **Software Update** — the update dialog is wider and shows release notes with proper formatting (group headings, bullets, and bold lead-ins) instead of raw Markdown, and the Dashboard banner and status-bar menu now show the download size when a new release is detected - **Main Window** — increased the default Dashboard window size so the 3-column module grid and detail pages fit comfortably on open - **Support Toolbox** — moved support links to a dedicated **Support Toolbox** sidebar page with prominent **Sponsor on GitHub** and **Support on Ko-fi** cards, a **Free Ways to Help** card grid, a high-five confetti button, and an honor-system **Supporter ♥** badge (shown in the sidebar, Settings, window titlebar, and a custom gold-accented Dock icon)
### Fixed - **Dock Click to Minimize** — Dock icons can be dragged to reorganise again; the click action now waits for the release and yields to the Dock whenever you drag, instead of firing on press and swallowing the gesture - **Accessibility & Permission Flow** — fixed a crash when closing the Accessibility explanation sheet, a Mac-wide input freeze when revoking Accessibility in System Settings, and a duplicate Accessibility prompt at startup; permission state no longer goes stale after changes in System Settings, and the Dashboard setup banner walks through Accessibility → Screen Recording step by step and returns you to Toolbox
